instruction.german: You get a birthday present from your aunt. It’s a yellow T-shirt, some green shorts and black socks. The clothes are from an environmentally-friendly shop. Write a thank you email.

parts:
Start your email like this:

Dear Aunt and Uncle,

Thank you for your birthday present.

 

Plan the rest of your email. Answer these questions:

Why do you like the clothes?

What do the colours mean to you?

 

You can start some of the sentences in your email with:

I like the T-shirt because it’s ...

(Yellow) is a ... colour.

I love (green).

The socks are ...

 

Finish your email like this:

Hope to see you soon and thanks again!

Love,

(Your name)
